 Kelly to host telephone town hall on Medicare Open Enrollment 
 Image November 16, 2026 Press Release WASHINGTON, D.C. --  On Wednesday, November 18, U.S. Rep. Mike Kelly (R-PA) will hold his annual telephone town hall regarding Medicare Open Enrollment. Kelly will be joined by officials from the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) and other guests during the call.
With Medicare enrollment season in full swing, the panel hopes the tele-town hall will answer questions for both new and current enrollees. Medicare Open Enrollment runs annually from October 15-December 7.
 "This time of year, we hear from many constituents who are seeking answers and clarity about the Medicare Open Enrollment process. Our tele-town hall gives seniors and their families the assistance they need from the comfort of their own home. I look forward to speaking with everyone during the event," said Rep. Kelly. 
 If a resident of Pennsylvania's 16th Congressional District would like to join the call, they are encouraged to use the pin-less participant dial-in number below. A livestream will also be available on Rep. Kelly's Facebook page. 
 DETAILS 
 Who:  U.S. Rep. Mike Kelly and officials from the Center for Medicare & Medicaid Services and Pennsylvania Medicare Education & Decision Insight
 What:  Live Telephone Town Hall on Medicare Open Enrollment
 When:  Wednesday, November 18, 2026 at 6:00p.m. ET
 Pin-less Participant Dial-in Number:  855-531-1063
 Livestream:   Facebook.com/MikeKellyPA
